CHIEF COMPLAINT
Left lower back pain.

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS
Patient is a male presenting with left-sided lower back pain. He reports history of back surgery in November 2020 for a microdiscectomy due to a herniated disk that wrapped around and compressed the spinal thecal sac. He experienced severe nerve pain radiating down his leg following the surgery and was treated with high-dose gabapentin, which was difficult to discontinue. Currently, he reports left-sided lower back pain that varies day to day and may occur on the right side as well, generally in the area of prior surgery. Pain is exacerbated by bending over and occurs randomly during the day. Stretching provides relief. He reports pain with weightbearing while standing. Current pain management includes ibuprofen 800 mg daily. Denies current leg pain or radiation of pain down legs.

REVIEW OF SYSTEMS
Denies nerve pain in legs. No other problems endorsed.

PAST MEDICAL HISTORY
Back surgery with microdiscectomy for herniated disk (November 2020).

MEDICATIONS
Ibuprofen 800 mg daily.

ALLERGIES
Not documented.

FAMILY HISTORY
Not documented.

SOCIAL HISTORY
Not documented.

PHYSICAL EXAMINATION
Patient able to bend forward without current pain, though reports this typically causes pain. No pain with extension. Pain present with weightbearing while standing. Tenderness to palpation on left side around L5. No tenderness to palpation on right side. Dorsiflexion normal. Normal lower extremity strength bilaterally. No focal neurological deficits.

RESULTS
X-ray of spine: No fractures noted. Surgical site shows appropriate healing with evidence of prior surgical intervention.

ASSESSMENT AND PLAN
Left lower back pain, likely musculoskeletal in nature secondary to spinal misalignment post-microdiscectomy. Plan includes: (1) Physical therapy referral; (2) Discontinue ibuprofen and initiate meloxicam for improved pain management; (3) Referral to pain management for comprehensive pain evaluation and discussion of non-narcotic pain management strategies; (4) Prescription for demerol.
